log.note: Root cause (measured): the right pane header was 1px taller than the left (split-close button 32px + 1px border > min-height 32), so the two header rules sat at y=146 vs 147 -- the visible step in 4.png. Fix in src/styles.css: .split-pane-header fixed box-sizing border-box height var(--control-height); .split-close height calc(control-height - 1px); .split-divider now 7px wide, margins 0 -4px 0 -3px so its 1px centre column is exactly the right pane's left edge. SplitDivider.tsx untouched (no hit-width constant there). Spec: tests/split-view.spec.ts new pixel-scan junction test, DPR 1+2 x light+dark x ratio 0.5/0.373 (8 cases): rule row continuous across divider, no 1px step, vertical line unbroken from toolbar rule to pane bottom, no spill beside it. Fail-first: on untouched tree all 4 cases failed (header bottoms 146 vs 147, rule row broken). After: 8/8 pass; full tests/split-view.spec.ts + tests/alignment.spec.ts 31/31 pass (Chromium, dev server port 1701). Light and dark junction crops viewed: clean. Hit area 6->7px, drag/keyboard unchanged (spec drag passes). Native WebKit not run. CLAIMED only.
